### Regions Bank and the Regions Foundation Announce Flood-Recovery Response for Indiana Communities


Aug 24, 2026


*Regions Bank is offering flood-relief financial assistance for consumers and businesses, while the Regions Foundation is supporting Red Cross response efforts.*


INDIANAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Regions Bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Bank&index=1&md5=424c815a437a467cd53c5a06dbcec223) on Monday announced a series of disaster-recovery financial services designed to help people and businesses in Indiana following catastrophic flooding that started Aug. 11, 2026. Additionally, the[Regions Foundation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Ffoundation&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Foundation&index=2&md5=c248fdf4d1c8770efeb9caa5309110f1) , a nonprofit funded primarily by Regions Bank, announced a commitment of $25,000 in grant funding to support[American Red Cross](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.redcross.org%2Fabout-us%2Fnews-and-events%2Fnews%2F2026%2Fred-cross-helps-as-storms-hit-illinois--indiana.html%3Fsrsltid%3DAfmBOop2pDkSP7rAaPyKP65m_K_5ld_azDOpOuCmoOTyo78gtEdJOwDJ&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=American+Red+Cross&index=3&md5=1b2623f2178bac61738ed7a03d866877) disaster relief efforts.


Regions Bank and the Regions Foundation Announce Flood-Recovery Response for Indiana Communities


The financial services announced by Regions Bank are available in portions of Indianapolis, Noblesville, Fishers and additional communities served by the bank. A full list of covered ZIP codes can be found below this announcement2. Additional areas may be added pending further assessments.


**Regions Bank’s Role – Serving and Supporting Indiana Neighbors:** “The scale of destruction is heartbreaking. Families are displaced, homes and businesses are damaged, and communities are facing a long road to recovery,” said[Jenny Lurkins](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregions.doingmoretoday.com%2Fregions-bank-elevates-jenny-lurkins-as-indianapolis-market-executive-and-commercial-banking-leader%2F&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=Jenny+Lurkins&index=4&md5=65de76908d0c62d7c3b642f84dbafab4) , Regions Bank’s Indianapolis market executive. “Our teams at Regions Bank are dedicated to listening to the people we serve and offering solutions to help them get through this time. Through special discounts, financial assistance programs, loan-relief options and fee waivers, we hope to ease some of the financial burden so those affected can focus on moving forward.”


**Options Available to Consumers:** For those impacted by the floods, options from Regions Bank, available for a limited time, include:


- Regions Mortgage Disaster Relief Purchase and Renovation loan programs. 1
- Regions will waive ATM surcharges for non-Regions customers using Regions ATMs in the impacted areas 2 through Aug. 31, 2026.
- Non-Regions ATM fees will be waived when Regions customers use other banks’ ATMs in the impacted areas 2 through Aug. 31, 2026. *(Note: Fees charged by other banks or ATM owners may still apply.)*
- No check-cashing fees will be charged for FEMA-issued checks when cashed in a Regions branch. 3
- Personal loan payment assistance is available. 4
- Payment deferrals are available for current credit card holders. 4
- One penalty-free CD withdrawal is available upon request (unless within seven days of issuance or renewal) through Nov. 20, 2026.
- An interest rate discount of up to 0.50% on new personal unsecured loans is available when customers in impacted areas apply in a branch or by phone 5. The offer is available through Nov. 20, 2026.
- An interest rate discount of up to 0.50% on non-business auto loans is available when customers in impacted areas apply in-branch or by phone 6. The offer is available through Nov. 20, 2026.


**Business Recovery Resources from Regions Bank:** Special business options available for a limited time in affected communities2 include:


- Business loan payment assistance is available. 4
- Business loan payment deferrals of up to 90 days are available, expiring Nov. 20, 2026. 4


**How Regions Bank Customers Can Access Support:**


- Regions Bank maintains a strong network of branches throughout Central Indiana, where people can turn for one-on-one consultation and support.
- For help with personal loans, credit cards, lines of credit, mortgage or home equity line of credit, customers can also call 1-800-221-7471.
- For help with any other banking need, customers can reach a Regions representative at 1-800-411-9393.


Customers are also encouraged to visit Regions Bank’s **Disaster Relief Center** at[www.regions.com/DisasterRelief](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2FDisasterRelief&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com%2FDisasterRelief&index=5&md5=4e606edcec9a795baad7be30ea972b3c) , as well as Regions’ **Customer Assistance Program** at[www.regions.com/help/customer-assistance-program](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fhelp%2Fcustomer-assistance-program&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com%2Fhelp%2Fcustomer-assistance-program&index=6&md5=895ebdadceca97785169d64d845214cd) , for timely information on financial recovery programs, loan assistance resources, and more.


“In times of hardship, access to reliable financial support can make a meaningful difference,” said **Tyler Lipe** , Consumer Banking Executive for Regions Bank. “We want customers to know help is available. Whether they connect with us through a local branch, our contact centers, or[online banking services](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Fpersonal-banking&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=online+banking+services&index=7&md5=c20cd6cbd03b65e40dfab85a6285da0f) , our teams are ready to discuss available options and provide support.”


**Regions Foundation – Providing Financial Support for Red Cross Efforts:** The $25,000 grant provided by the Regions Foundation will support Red Cross disaster-relief and recovery efforts actively serving communities affected by flood devastation.


“The Red Cross has mobilized around the clock to support families by providing shelter, meals, personal items, medications and financial assistance for people who are affected,” said **Marta Mendes-Miguel Self** , executive director of the Regions Foundation. “We want to help ensure volunteer efforts can continue uninterrupted, and providing resources to further enable recovery is one of the best ways we can serve.”


Together, Regions Bank and the Regions Foundation are supporting both immediate disaster response and long-term financial assistance efforts, helping individuals, families and businesses across Indiana recover and rebuild following the floods.


**About Regions Financial Corporation** Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $161 billion in assets, is a member of the S&P 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. Regions serves customers across the South, Midwest and Texas, and through its subsidiary, Regions Bank, operates more than 1,200 banking offices and more than 1,750 ATMs. Regions Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC. Additional information about Regions and its full line of products and services can be found at[www.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com&index=8&md5=bc4c748d5795f2a13f79d3b23459c45e) .


**About the Regions Foundation** The Alabama‑based Regions Foundation supports community investments that positively impact communities served by Regions Bank. The Foundation engages in a grantmaking program focused on priorities including economic and community development; education and workforce readiness; and financial wellness. The Foundation is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) corporation funded primarily through contributions from Regions Bank. To learn more about the Regions Foundation, visit[www.regions.com/foundation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2Ffoundation&esheet=54593125&newsitemid=20260824802728&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com%2Ffoundation&index=9&md5=541f584c4292ba53a24fc9382712980f) .

Forbearances, skipped payments and deferrals (a) may vary by customer, (b) postpone – rather than forgive – certain payment obligations and (c) may require payment in full of the postponed payments at the end of the forbearance or deferral period, in addition to any other amounts that come due, unless you make other arrangements with Regions to resolve the delinquency.


5 New personal unsecured loan and new auto loan rate discounts may not be combined with other special offers or discounts.


6 You must have a deposit account with Regions that has been open for at least six months in order to be eligible for an automobile loan. Auto loan rate discount of up to 0.50% includes 0.25% disaster relief rate discount with an additional 0.25% rate discount when you enroll in auto debit payments from an existing Regions checking account. Auto loan rate discounts cannot be combined with other special offers or discounts.
